name: Syncthing
param_style: ? positional (sqlx over database/sql; mattn or modernc sqlite); statements are text/template strings with flag constants rendered at open
data_scale: scale 1: 1 folder DB with 5 devices (local + 4 remote), 40k names, 320 version vectors, ~152k files rows + fileinfos, ~55k blocklists, ~92k blocks, 5k mtimes, ~300 kv rows (~55 MB)
visibility_note: ~90k stars; v2 (2025) moved the whole index database from LevelDB to SQLite, so these are the sync engine's hot paths on every install
interest_note: Need/global queries: UNION ALL of correlated NOT EXISTS / EXISTS self-joins over files+devices, grouped for completion counts; bitmask flag predicates everywhere; per-file upserts with RETURNING that fire counts/indexids triggers; INSERT OR REPLACE on a unique index; chunked multi-row block inserts into WITHOUT ROWID tables.
reach_note: packaged in all major distros, Android forks and NAS app stores; SQLite backend since v2
